notes.note: Cross-station reads now also covers the read-only history relay (GET /api/environments/ssh/sessions/:environmentId/:threadId/history): same tunnel, outbound peer bearer and orchestration:operate leaf, never dials, refuses mismatched or over-2,000-event pages, caps at the remote's 20-turn and 512-char cursor bounds, labels from this Station's profile, and maps a remote 401 to a 409 authentication_required. Checked against ssh-environments.ts, remote-session-reader.ts and its route/reader tests.

Added that the remote list includes external sessions the remote Station found on its own computer, that opening one shows history read-only with continuation disabled, and the remoteSessionHistory flag fallback. Checked against RemoteSessionReaderHost.tsx, work-item-open-policy.ts and station-capability-flags.ts.

Documented fetchRemoteSessionHistory and readRemoteSessionHistoryCapability, both exported from packages/sdk/src/query-domains/sshEnvironments.ts through queries.ts and index.ts; failure behavior matches the route's error sentences.

Attached external session follow now says each Station reads only its own computer's provider files and remote sessions arrive through that computer's Station over a connected SSH environment (remote-session-reader.ts); no daemon, no source handle crossing. Other claims unchanged.
